quote:
In the quiet of a moonlit night, a humble heart may outshine the brightest star.  

When the sky sears with an unyielding blaze, even the merriment of a celebration can fade into hush.  

A field left dusted after polls rests, yet its seed of destiny grows beyond the reach of ordinary sight.  

A sea of people can amplify a single sorrow, though the melody of the lone heart still plays alone.  

Beauty may hide a peril like mist; the true danger is that which the eye does not see.  

When the earth trembles beneath its own weight, the living must become the silent guardians for those beneath.  

When a nation begs for motion, the wind rises to carry its longing across the horizon.
quote_preview: In the quiet of a moonlit night, a humble heart may outshine the brightest star.
